alhambra.name: Alhambra
alhambra.price_text: Approx. €10–20 general entry, varies by ticket type; Nasrid Palaces need a timed slot
alhambra.hours: Daily, roughly 08:30–20:00 in peak season; check on the day
alhambra.tip: Book a timed entry online weeks ahead, because daytime slots sell out fast.
alhambra.best: Early morning or late afternoon; spring and autumn are most comfortable

generalife.name: Generalife
generalife.price_text: Included in Alhambra ticket with a timed slot; check current rules
generalife.hours: Daily, roughly 08:30–20:00 in season; check on the day
generalife.tip: Visit the gardens and water channels after the palaces, when the crowds have thinned.
generalife.best: Late afternoon in spring or early autumn

albayzin.name: Albayzín
albayzin.tip: Wander the whitewashed lanes and stop at small squares for views of the Alhambra.

granada_cathedral.name: Granada Cathedral
granada_cathedral.hours: Mon–Sat roughly 10:30–18:30; Sun afternoons only; check on the day
granada_cathedral.tip: Go up to the roof for views, and check the chapel opening times before you go.
granada_cathedral.best: Late morning; avoid the midday tour rush

royal_chapel.name: Royal Chapel of Granada
royal_chapel.hours: Mon–Sat roughly 10:30–18:30; Sun afternoons; check on the day
royal_chapel.tip: See the royal tombs of Ferdinand and Isabella, then the small museum with their personal items.

old_town.name: Granada Old Town
old_town.tip: Start at Plaza Bib-Rambla and walk toward the cathedral through the shopping streets.

alhambra_palaces.name: Nasrid Palaces
alhambra_palaces.price_text: Included in Alhambra ticket; timed slot required
alhambra_palaces.hours: Timed slots through the day; check on the day
alhambra_palaces.tip: Book the palace slot first, since it is the most limited part of the ticket.
alhambra_palaces.best: Morning, when the light is good

alhambra_night.name: Alhambra night visit
alhambra_night.price_text: Approx. €15–25 for night tickets; check current price
alhambra_night.hours: Evenings in season; check on the day
alhambra_night.tip: Choose a night ticket for a quieter, lit-up visit, and bring a light jacket.

generalife_gardens.name: Generalife gardens
generalife_gardens.hours: Same as Generalife; check on the day
generalife_gardens.tip: Walk the long pool and cypress paths for the quietest part of the complex.

cathedral_roof.name: Cathedral roof and tower visit
cathedral_roof.price_text: Included in cathedral ticket or extra; check on the day
cathedral_roof.hours: Tied to cathedral hours; check on the day
cathedral_roof.tip: Climb to the roof early, since the stairs get busy by late morning.

albayzin_sunset.name: Albayzín sunset walk
albayzin_sunset.price_text: Free to walk; guided tours approx. €15–30
albayzin_sunset.hours: Best 1 hour before sunset; check on the day
albayzin_sunset.tip: Plan to reach the viewpoints 30 minutes before sunset to find a spot.

royal_chapel_tombs.name: Royal tombs and museum
royal_chapel_tombs.hours: Same as chapel; check on the day
royal_chapel_tombs.tip: Look at the Gothic tombs first, then the museum rooms with paintings and royal objects.

sacromonte_flamenco.name: Sacromonte flamenco show
sacromonte_flamenco.price_text: Approx. €25–40 incl. one drink; check current price
sacromonte_flamenco.hours: Evening shows, usually one or two sittings; check on the day
sacromonte_flamenco.tip: Book a cave venue in advance and ask whether drinks are included.

san_agustin_market.name: San Agustín food market
san_agustin_market.price_text: Pay for what you eat; tapas approx. €3–8
san_agustin_market.hours: Typically weekday daytime; check on the day
san_agustin_market.tip: Sample local produce and tapas, and ask vendors what is in season.

hammam.name: Hammam Al Ándalus baths
hammam.price_text: Approx. €25–40 per session; check current price
hammam.hours: Daily sessions; booking required; check on the day
hammam.tip: Book a time slot ahead and bring flip-flops and a towel if the venue says to.
hammam.best: Late afternoon, after a long walk

mirador_san_nicolas.name: Mirador de San Nicolás
mirador_san_nicolas.tip: Go at sunset for the classic view of the Alhambra and the Sierra Nevada.

darro_walk.name: Carrera del Darro riverside walk
darro_walk.tip: Walk the river path below the Albayzín for a calm, shady stroll.

realejo_walk.name: Realejo Jewish quarter walk
realejo_walk.price_text: Free to walk; guided tours approx. €15–25
realejo_walk.tip: Stroll the quiet streets, then stop for a drink at a local bar.
